subject.title: Feature: Subscribe to WhatsApp call events (Baileys)

question: Should inbound WhatsApp Baileys call events be exposed to agents, and which opt-in, retention, filtering, and hook/tool/session surface should own sanitized call activity?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but call metadata is privacy-sensitive and the permanent exposure surface is a product/security boundary that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Default-off sanitized plugin path
options.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned opt-in listener that exposes only filtered call activity metadata after existing access-control checks.

options.title: Defer inbound call tracking
options.body: Keep the outbound MeowCaller tool only and leave this issue open or close it only after maintainers decide that contact-history call tracking is out of scope.

options.title: External plugin first
options.body: Require a separate plugin/API proposal if maintainers want inbound call tracking outside the bundled WhatsApp plugin.

recommendation.title: Default-off sanitized plugin path
recommendation.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned opt-in listener that exposes only filtered call activity metadata after existing access-control checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He recently owned the related WhatsApp call feature and already commented with the product/security boundaries for this request.
